paragraphs.source_en: Chief Tachibana stood staring abstractedly at the gruesome pool of blood, but all at once shook his head fiercely. "Mr. Kindaichi, I don't like this case. Why decapitate the body? Why put the head on the chrysanthemum doll? I don't like it at all. It just gives me the chills."
